summary:
CLIMATO is a bilingual (Arabic/English) geospatial climate intelligence platform focused on Egypt and the Nile Delta. It brings live weather, 7-day forecasts, and climate-risk indicators into one interactive web experience built around a 3D satellite globe. Users can search any city or coordinate and instantly see temperature, humidity, wind, soil moisture, and a composite risk score covering coastal exposure, urban heat, agricultural moisture stress, and dust.

The platform addresses the gap between complex Earth-observation data and the people who need to act on it, such as farmers, planners, and businesses. It organizes satellite sources like NASA and Copernicus into practical modules for crop health, urban heat islands, air quality, water monitoring, and ESG reporting, with alerts and exportable reports.

This matters because Egypt is highly exposed to sea-level rise, heat, and water stress, yet accessible, Arabic-first climate tools are scarce. CLIMATO makes climate risk understandable and actionable at the local level.
details:
What it does. CLIMATO is a bilingual (Arabic/English) climate intelligence web platform focused on Egypt and the Nile Delta. A 3D interactive satellite globe sits at the center of the experience. Users can search any city or coordinate and instantly see current temperature, humidity, wind speed, precipitation, and soil moisture, plus a 7-day forecast. A composite climate-risk score summarizes four dimensions: coastal exposure, urban heat, agricultural moisture stress, and dust and aerosols. The platform is organized into modules for crop health, urban heat islands, air quality, water monitoring, and ESG reporting.

How it works. Live weather and forecasts are fetched in real time from the Open-Meteo API. The risk indices are demonstration estimates computed from coordinates, not measured satellite values, and the interface labels them as sample data. The full version runs on an Express and SQLite backend with alerts, reports, and workspaces. A standalone single-file version runs directly in the browser with live weather only.

Impact. Egypt is highly exposed to sea-level rise, extreme heat, and water stress, yet Arabic-first climate tools are scarce. CLIMATO aims to make climate risk understandable for farmers, planners, and businesses at the local level.

Tools. React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Three.js, Node.js, Express, SQLite, Open-Meteo API.

Creativity. A cinematic, bilingual interface that turns complex Earth-observation concepts into an approachable experience, with honest data labeling throughout.

Factors considered. Accessibility in Arabic, transparency about sample versus live data, and a lightweight deployment that works with no server.

SI use. The code was developed with assistance from Google AI Studio and Claude.
